build_rainbow_transformation_tree: build a RainbowTransformationTree that creates a tree of rotation, scale, and color transformations
create_rotation_transformations: create batched rotation transformations using get_rotations with torchvision RandomAffine
create_scale_transformations: create batched scale transformations using get_scales with torchvision RandomAffine
change_background_color_images: change the background color of BCHW tensor images from black to a new RGB color
compute_transformation_similarity: compute similarity between two transformation paths by comparing matching operations
